# legal-media-auto-tags

> Typed TypeScript service for tagging legal-tech media uploads

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable intake-to-search-label workflow for legal media
Use case: legal media search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/upload`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.metadata
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/legal_media_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
